messages:
maria: Hey folks — thinking about a low-key Friday evening: happy hour + board games at The Ferry (dockside patio) 6:30pm–9pm. Pizza + soft drinks, maybe BYOB. Who's in? :game_die: :pizza:

ev an: Count me in! I can bring Codenames and Wingspan. vegetarian pizza ok?

lena: Love this. 6:30 works for me. +1 on veg options, and I can grab some snacks (chips/dips).

sarah: Ill try to book a spot for ~8 people. Do we want to put in a small shared tab for pizza/soft drinks? (:thumbsup: if yes)

mike: thumbs up. I can cover a $40 tab and we can Venmo/PayPal later. Also can remote folks Zoom in? My partner has a portable phone stand we can use for a camera angle on the table.

maria: @mike amazing, thanks. @sarah if you can book that'd be great. @lena bring snacks is perfect. I'll DM a quick list of dietary prefs.

lunchbot: Poll created: "Start time" options: 6:30pm, 7:00pm, 7:30pm — vote with :one: :two: :three:. (poll id 8921)

evan: voted :one: (6:30)

lena: voted :one: (6:30)

mike: voted :two: (7:00)

sarah: booked table for 8 at The Ferry patio, reservation name: RedwoodTeam, 6:30pm. ETA: 8 people max, can adjust.

maria: Awesome, thank you! Quick logistics: nearest transit is Harbor Line stop. There's limited street parking after 6pm.

evan: I can drive a couple folks if needed (3 seats).

lena: remote folks — we can stream from a phone on tripod, but maybe bring a digital game option too? Tabletop simulator?

mike: I'll throw a quick google sheet for signups + dietary notes. Link: https://tiny.redwood/pizza-signup (placeholder)

sarah: If anyone wants to bring a game, leave the name on the sheet. I'll add Codenames + Wingspan to the list.

maria: Any objections to a light theme — "retro board games"? costumes optional :grin:

evan: Ha, I'll bring my old Uno deck. 90s vibes.

lena: No objections. Costumes optional but encouraged.

mike: Remote buddy who can't make it in person wants to join Zoom around 7pm — ok to shift one game later if needed?

sarah: We can plan to start casual mingle at 6:30 and start structured games at ~7:15 so remote folks can join.

maria: Perfect. Final checklist: @sarah reserves (done), @mike tab, @lena snacks, @evan games, Ill handle pizza order (veg + 2 meat).

lunchbot: Reminder set: "Friday game night - bring games/snacks" 2026-04-03 17:00 (local)

evan: Excited. See you Friday! :tada:

lena: See ya — bringing extra napkins :joy:

mike: If anyone changes plans, post here. Otherwise see you at The Ferry!
